title: ConnectAndSell Pricing in 2026: No Public Price, What the Plans Include
summary: ConnectAndSell publishes no prices: Express Connect and Precision Connect are seat-based and sold by quote. See what each plan lists and the free Test Drive.
body_markdown:
ConnectAndSell does not publish prices. Its pricing page lists four offers. The Test Drive Experience is free and lasts one day. Flight School, Express Connect and Precision Connect are each labeled Seat Based, with a Contact Sales button and no dollar amount. The page says there are no consumption-based fees. It states no seat minimum and no contract term. The pages were read on November 18, 2026.


Trellus publishes this guide and sells a competing dialer. Every ConnectAndSell detail below comes from ConnectAndSell's own website, opened on November 18, 2026. No price here comes from a review site. No ConnectAndSell account or Test Drive was used and nothing was tested. For a feature-by-feature view, see[Trellus vs. ConnectAndSell](https://www.trellus.ai/compare/trellus-vs-connectandsell) .


## ConnectAndSell pricing at a glance

Below the cards, a section called How Our Pricing Works makes three statements. Pricing is seat-based, so a customer pays for each active user on the platform. There are no consumption-based fees for call volume or usage. And the page says there are no surprise charges for additional features or call volumes.


The pricing page and the product menu name the two connection products Express Connect and Precision Connect. ConnectAndSell's[Flight School page](https://connectandsell.com/flight-school/) and[customer success page](https://connectandsell.com/customer-success/) also use an older product name, ConnectAndSell Lightning. No Lightning plan appears on the pricing page.


## What changes the real cost of ConnectAndSell


The price comes from a sales conversation, so the useful question is what goes into the quote. ConnectAndSell's pages point to the items below.


### Express Connect or Precision Connect


The two paid connection plans differ in who the rep is handed. On the[Express Connect page](https://connectandsell.com/express-connect/) , AI dials, works through phone trees and routes calls. The rep takes over at the first human voice, which the page says may be a gatekeeper, a receptionist or a decision-maker.


The[Precision Connect page](https://connectandsell.com/precision-connect/) describes human agents who work through phone systems and gatekeepers. The call is transferred to the rep once the intended decision-maker is reached. ConnectAndSell calls this model Human + AI.


The pricing page gives no price for either plan and does not say how the two compare in cost. Ask for a quote on each.


### Seats


The pricing page says a customer pays for each active user on the platform. It states no seat minimum and does not define an active user. Ask whether managers who listen and coach need a seat, and how seats are added or removed during a term.


### Call volume and phone data


The page says there are no consumption-based fees and no charges based on call volume. Both connection plans list full coverage with no phone number restrictions, and unlimited phone number enrichment. ConnectAndSell's[page for sales reps](https://connectandsell.com/for-sales-reps/) says the platform enables 100 or more dials per hour.


The pages read do not mention phone numbers for caller ID, international calling rates or taxes. Ask how each is handled in the quote.


### CASSi


Both connection plans list the CASSi AI assistant. ConnectAndSell's[home page](https://connectandsell.com/) describes CASSi as an AI agent that supplies phone numbers, orders outreach by phone number intent, transcribes calls, summarizes notes and scores conversations against a skill rubric. The pricing page lists no separate charge for it.


### Training and customer success


Flight School is its own card on the pricing page, labeled Seat Based, for up to 5 students. The Flight School page lists four lessons: Takeoff, Free Flight, Handling Turbulence and Landing. Its price is not published.


Express Connect and Precision Connect each list a dedicated customer success manager. The customer success page describes onboarding with personalized training.


### Integrations


ConnectAndSell's[platform page](https://connectandsell.com/platform/) lists integrations with Salesforce, HubSpot and Microsoft Dynamics, with Outreach and Salesloft, and with Gong and Chorus. The pricing page does not say whether any integration is priced separately.


### Contract terms


The pricing page states no contract length, renewal rule or monthly option. Its footer refers to Terms of Use, but no terms of service or subscription agreement was found among the pages listed in the site's own sitemap on November 18, 2026. Ask for the term, the renewal date and the cancellation notice period in writing.


## Who ConnectAndSell fits and who it does not


ConnectAndSell fits a team whose prospects sit behind phone trees, receptionists and assistants, and that wants a vendor to handle that step. Precision Connect is built around it: the home page says human agents broker the exchange with executive assistants and gatekeepers, then connect the rep to the named person.


It also fits a team that wants training and hands-on help along with the software. The pricing page lists instructor-led Flight School and a dedicated customer success manager on both connection plans.


A team can see the product before it buys. The Test Drive Experience is listed as free, lasts one day, uses the team's own data and messaging and needs no CRM integration. The[Test Drive page](https://connectandsell.com/test-drive-experience/) describes it as live calling with live results.


ConnectAndSell is a weaker fit for a buyer who needs a public price to build a budget or to compare vendors quickly. No paid offer has a price, and no contract terms are published. It is also not the match for someone who wants to buy a seat online the same day. The pricing page offers Contact Sales and Request Demo buttons, not a checkout.


The platform page shows ConnectAndSell's own session page for reps, with integrations that sync activity back to the CRM. A team that wants reps to dial inside the CRM itself is looking for a different kind of product.

Trellus does not list a human navigation service. When a call reaches a switchboard or an assistant, the rep has that conversation. ConnectAndSell's Precision Connect is the plan to ask about if that step is the one you want handled for you.

## Frequently asked questions


### How much does ConnectAndSell cost?


ConnectAndSell does not publish a price. Its pricing page labels Flight School, Express Connect and Precision Connect as Seat Based, each with a Contact Sales button and no dollar amount. Any figure from another website is not ConnectAndSell's own.


### Does ConnectAndSell offer a free trial?


The pricing page lists a free Test Drive Experience. It is described as one day on ConnectAndSell, led by experts, with your own data and messaging and no CRM integration required. The page lists no other free plan or trial.


### What is the difference between Express Connect and Precision Connect?


Express Connect connects the rep to the first live voice, which may be a gatekeeper, a receptionist or a decision-maker. Precision Connect uses human agents to get past gatekeepers and transfers the call when the named person on the list is reached. Neither has a published price.


### Does ConnectAndSell charge for call volume?


Its pricing page says no. It describes seat-based pricing with no consumption-based fees and no charges based on call volume or usage. Both connection plans list unlimited phone number enrichment. Ask for the same wording in the order form.


### Is there a seat minimum or a contract term for ConnectAndSell?


Neither is published. The pricing page states no seat minimum, contract length or renewal rule, and no terms of service was found on the site on November 18, 2026. Flight School is listed for up to 5 students.


### Which ConnectAndSell alternatives publish their prices?


Trellus lists Power at $99.99 and Power + Parallel at $149.99 per seat a month. WAVV Multi Line is $149 billed monthly, read on November 18, 2026. CallCloud's Parallel Dialer was $125 on November 17, 2026. Salesfinity Gold was $299 month to month on November 11, 2026.
